causes: First preview is sent in the same activation as actual E supply recovery; the source extension correctly refuses the unresolved transfer.
The failed target was permanently marked preview_started, so no legal later attempt could occur.

When reuse2 changes to loading, waiting-only target enumeration incorrectly skips it and previews reuse3 early. Its .07-second ACK refresh chain makes the own capture .06 old; the unchanged .05 limit correctly refuses.
changes: Actual delivered terminal own-action and existing +.5 headway maturity gate.
Earliest unselected known job includes loading and cannot be skipped.
At most two opportunities per job, each requires a new local physical/ACK fingerprint.
Only successful worker submission marks the target finished.
Preview may have no local L trigger; execution still requires a later actual local L current collection.
not_changed: full current candidate and per-job immutable baseline guard
caveat: Existing peer quiet intervals remain; a new preview can delay a physical policy admission even though physics and the worker do not block. New native calibration must measure this control cost.
